gazette_location.description_raw_en: No. 3083.— It is hereby notified that the following street(s)/road(s) will be known in future as described hereunder:— Description: Road commencing at its junction with Lion Rock Tunnel Road and running easterly for about 20 metres and then curves to run in a northerly direction for about 80 metres where it bends to run in a westerly direction for about 170 metres and temporarily terminates as shown dotted black on Drawing No. NTA/ST/R8. (It should be noted that the future extension of this road is under construction). Proposed Name: MAN LAM ROAD. Chinese Version: 文林路.

No. 3083.— It is hereby notified that the following street(s)/road(s) will be known in future as described hereunder:— Description: Road commencing at its junction with Man Lam Road near the northeast portion of Sha Tin Clinic and running in a south-easterly direction for about 115 metres where it bends to run in a south-westerly direction for about 140 metres and temporarily terminates near the southern end of Sha Tin Town Lot No. 20 as shown hatched black on Drawing No. NTA/ST/R8. (It should be noted that the future extension of this road is under construction). Proposed Name: MAN LAI ROAD. Chinese Version: 文禮路.
